outline.unique_angle: Every top-ranking page blames 'skipped daily job' on sleep/shutdown or on a KeepAlive+StartInterval conflict. None covers the failure mode where the job IS firing, IS exiting 0, but launchd silently swallows the run because ThrottleInterval sits too close to the 24h period — and the skip log line is byte-for-byte easy to mistake for success. The concrete artefact (real '71190s ago' log, the 22h→18h fix, the 6h-margin rule) is the differentiator the docs and forum threads lack.
